tools.name: quote_real_world_answer
tools.description: Get a free, immutable price quote for verifying a current fact about a US local business (stock, price, availability, capability, policy, wait time). Returns quote_id, price in integer minor units, scope, expected_completion_seconds and expires_at. Use purchase_quote to buy it.

tools.name: quote_real_world_action
tools.description: Get a free price to ARRANGE something at a specific US local business: book an appointment, hold an item, request a formal quote, or cancel a prior booking. This creates a real obligation, so it needs explicit authorization, the customer's name and callback number, and a maximum price the caller may

tools.name: purchase_quote
tools.description: The single purchase path: pays for a quote from EITHER quote_real_world_answer or quote_real_world_action and starts the job. There is no separate action-purchase tool. tools.description: Read-only progress check on a job bought with purchase_quote. Free, changes nothing, and safe to call repeatedly. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "quote_real_world_action" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: purchase_quote · Public sink: purchase_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: purchase_quote · Public sink: purchase_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
